title: Cut from video by Regista's vision layer
subtitle: Regista watched a broadcast it rendered, with no event data, and found the players, the ball and the moments itself.
note: Cut from video by Regista's vision layer, run offline on Regista's own rendered broadcast of development match syn_0201 (seed 201, 640x360, 10 fps, no captions, no name labels or ball-holder ring). Possessions, events, appearances and player identity come from the video, not from the generator; the score counts goals the vision layer spotted. Tracks are downsampled to 1 Hz for size.

rendering.models: vision v4: shot model, kit-number reader, identity configuration and event spotter, trained on footage without captions, name labels or holder ring

tracks_trimmed.how: regista.vision.package: downsample_tracks, then trim_tracks (what the renderer reads)
